DARKROOM WORKSHOPS

Learn to develop your first roll of film and print your first black&white photo while listening to my CD/Vinyl collection and sipping on a glass of wine, a cold beer, or a warm cup of tea.

WHAT YOU'LL LEARN

  • Loading film onto reels in complete darkness
  • Developing, agitation, and timing
  • Printing contact sheets
  • Making photographic prints on an enlarger and developing them in chemistry
  • Perfecting prints with dodging and burning and contrast filters
